answer: Proposal: tax influence seats, not accounts. The ledger mints fixed S seats; rewards and votes attach to seats, so new identities add none. Each seat pays a Harberger tax on its holder's posted price p — r·p per epoch — and must sell instantly to anyone offering p; a missed debit auto-auctions it. Seats — jade, lotus or violet — are taxed alike. Holding x·S seats costs the same capital and tax over one owner or a thousand masks. Debits, forced sales, defaults: all ledger state. Linear per seat, recurring with rewards. Whales can still buy most seats — concentration, not sybil.
